hooks.text: 把连续冲刺、攻击、技能和强力招式串成强调动量的高速战斗流
hooks.excerpt: Your godlike speed is key to surviving the all-consuming Vortex threatening your world; stay aggressive and overwhelm the battlefield - before it overwhelms you. Chain dashes, strikes, abilities and devastating power moves together in hyper-fast combat built around flow.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 双持不同武器组合专属动作与Alterattack，再从170多项解锁物中配装
hooks.excerpt: Dual wield to combine unique weapon movesets, unleash powerful Alterattacks, and customize your build with over 170+ unlockables . The playstyle is yours to create: Mix fast melee weapons with heavy hitters (including the fan-favourite Crocojaw, known for its brutal bite!), ranged tools, status effects, mobility skills and more to become the unstoppable force on the battlefield.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 失败也能带回资源，在方舟解锁新武器与能力扩展后续构筑
hooks.excerpt: Every failed run lets you bring back valuable resources to unlock new weapons, powers and upgrades at the Ark, expanding future builds and playstyles. Learn enemy patterns, try a new loadout, and come back stronger every time. No drawback to experimenting, so go forward, Leaper!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
